summary: The implementation matches the specification: CancunGasCalculator.computeExcessBlobGas returns 0 when parent excess plus parent blob gas used is below TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (0x60000) and otherwise returns the difference. ExcessBlobGasCalculator defaults missing parent excess_blob_gas and blob_gas_used to 0 via orElse(0L), correctly handling the first post-fork block, and AbstractBlockCreator uses this value for the new block header and blob gas price.
